01

A report before the first cited verse

A report transmitted from Abū Wāʾil Shaqīq ibn Salama.

01
Report from Abū Wāʾil 01

Abū Wāʾil Shaqīq ibn Salama

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabiʿ narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash and ʿAsim ibn Abi al-Najud narrated to us, from Abu Wa’il Shaqiq ibn Salama, who said:
“Quraysh said to the Prophet (ﷺ): ‘Trace the lineage of your Lord for us.’ So God revealed this surah, and said: ‘O Muhammad, trace My lineage to this.’”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، قَالَ: ثنا الْأَعْمَشُ، وَعَاصِمُ بْنُ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ شَقِيقِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ:
" قَالَتْ قُرَيْشٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ انْسُبْ لَنَا رَبَّكَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ، فَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ انْسُبْنِي إِلَى هَذَا "

02

“the Eternal Refuge (al-Samad)”

Three explanations transmitted from Shaqīq ibn Salama, Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb al-Quraẓī (Q 112:2).

02
Explanation from Shaqīq 02

Shaqīq ibn Salama

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Hibban narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Shaqiq ibn Salama, who said:
the Eternal Refuge (al-Samad) [al-Ikhlas: 2]: “the master whose mastery has reached its utmost limit.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَبَّانُ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ:
الصَّمَدُ [الإخلاص: 2] «السَّيِّدُ الَّذِي قَدِ انْتَهَى سُؤْدُدُهُ»
Edition record 373961 · p. 760Link to report ↗
03
Report from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
“The Samad is the one who has no hollow interior.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الصَّمَدُ: الَّذِي لَا جَوْفَ لَهُ "
Edition record 373962 · p. 760Link to report ↗
04
Report from Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb 04

Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb al-Quraẓī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Abu Maʿshar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Kaʿb al-Qurazi, who said:
“The Samad is the One who neither begets nor is begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبِ الْقُرَظِيِّ، قَالَ:
" الصَّمَدُ: هُوَ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ، وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ "
